about_the_game:
What would you do if you were the owner of a civilisation ? In Bobbies Evolution you get your chance! You command a little world inhabited by charming Bobbies beings that adapt and learn using real machine learning. Every Bobbie in your civilization remembers your actions, so no playthrough is ever the same.

Take on the role of an all-seeing creator: you can guide your Bobbies toward a golden era or test them with calamities. Will you be a kind deity or a capricious tyrant? Your divine interventions might rescue your people from a pandemic  or even start one yourself! Democracies can blossom in your cities  or you can crush them with a mere snap of your fingers and plunge the world into chaos. The moral dilemmas will keep you on your toes: do you save your civilization when war rages, or watch them learn from the consequences?

Bobbies AI is your playground. This is an experimental sandbox where your choices trigger unpredictable responses. Minor conflicts can escalate into full-scale warfare; a simple illness might evolve into an all-consuming plague if you let it be. Thanks to machine learning, the Bobbies truly grow smarter  maybe even questioning a Creatir that repeatedly sends meteors crashing down on them! Bobbies Evolution isnt just a simulation  its a living civilization crafted by your decisions and a capricious AI.

No god is complete without miracles and disasters. You wield divine powers at your fingertips. Build paradisiacal havens for your Bobbies, bless them with innovations and watch them erect monuments in your honor  or set wildfires, famine, and discord if your divine mood demands it. Every action ripples through their society. Bobbies can thrive in peaceful trade and democratic prosperity, or collapse under tyranny and plagues  and its you who decides.

Key Features:

Self-learning Bobbies: Your Bobbies harness machine learning to evolve their intelligence. They analyze your interventions and adapt  so be ready for surprises in every playthrough!

Good or Evil: You control it all! Choose to shower your Bobbies with benevolence or devastate them with calamities. The world reacts dynamically whether you opt to be a kind deity or a ruthless tyrant, and you can change course anytime.

Dynamic Sandbox World: Experience a simulated civilization where political choices and natural disasters intertwine. Launch pandemics, spark wars, or build a utopia  every decision shapes the course of history, and no two worlds evolve alike.

Experiment with Morality: Bobbies Evolution is an experiment in divine leadership. Set your own rules, watch real-time consequences unfold, and learn from the bizarre stories that emerge. The game challenges you with ethical choices, but it doesnt judge  with great power comes wildly unpredictable fun!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core (e.g. Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU with at least 4 GB VRAM (e.g. NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: 6- or 8-core (e.g. Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or 9)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern GPU with at least 8 GB VRAM (e.g. NVIDIA RTX 2070/3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: AI-powered god game where you nurture a civilization of Bobbies little beings that learn from your actions using machine learning. Be a benevolent deity or a ruthless tyrant: help or hinder them, and watch your unique world unfold.
